title: Billing
description: Review your plan and choose a hosted or demo checkout flow.
paymentEnabledBody: Payment is enabled. STOA will open a secure checkout when a plan is selected.
paymentDisabledBody: Payment is disabled. Use this page to review plan fit with families.
mockCheckoutEnabled: Demo checkout is enabled, so plan selection opens a virtual checkout for demos and tests.
mockCheckoutDisabled: Demo checkout is disabled. Live checkout will open when payment setup is available.
planLoading: Plan details are loading from the billing plans contract.
limitsBody: Plan limits shown in the demo are guidance for students and families. Live access rules are handled by STOA services.
securityBody: Hosted checkout is the preferred real payment direction. The browser never receives card details or payment secrets.
teacherUpgradeReason: Choose a plan with professional teacher support.
parentReportReason: A family plan is required for reports.

free_trial.name: Free trial
free_trial.audience: Families who want to try STOA before choosing a plan.

student.name: Student plan
student.audience: A focused learner who needs steady homework support.

family.name: Family plan
family.audience: Parents who want a clear view of progress.

tutor_supported.name: Teacher-supported plan
tutor_supported.audience: Families who want professional teacher support when students need more guidance.
